title: Profile registry
description: List of Profiles. A Profile groups Characteristics so results can show how many of them the user shows; it is a self-reflection aid and never a diagnosis.

id.description: Unique snake_case identifier, at most 3 words.

name.description: Label shown to the user in results, at most 9 words.

description.description: Neutral explanation of what the Profile groups, at most 29 words.

reference.description: Where the Characteristic selection comes from, at most 29 words.

characteristics.description: Ids of the Characteristics that make up the Profile. The Profile score is the mean of the scores of those already evaluated, weighted_score is the same mean weighting Characteristics listed by fewer Profiles more, and the Profile is well explored only when enough of them are measured.
